weight_management_program.text:
PRIMARY CARE PROGRESS NOTE
Date: 12/16/2025
S: 48 y/o M wants to lose weight; gained after a knee injury limited activity last year (now healed). Late-night snacking and takeout. Enjoys swimming.
O: Wt 75.7 kg, Ht 160 cm, BMI 29.6. BP 132/87.
Exam: CV RRR, no edema.

A/P:
1. Overweight, BMI 29.6 — plan starting today:
 - Calorie tracking, ~1800 kcal/day; cut late-night snacking and takeout.
 - Water aerobics / lap swimming 4 times a week.
 - Referred to a dietitian-led weight management program.
 Follow-up in ~3 months.
2. Elevated BP — 132/87 today, above goal; no prior diagnosis of hypertension. Recheck at next visit; home readings requested.
3. Anxiety — stable on sertraline.

NUTRITION CONSULT — INITIAL
Date: 12/31/2025
Dietitian-led program intake. Food log: skips breakfast, heavy dinner, takeout 3–4 nights, snacks 10 PM–midnight.
Plan: calorie tracking at ~1800 kcal/day; breakfast daily; takeout 1x/week; no eating after 9 PM; lower sodium given BP readings.
Activity: water aerobics / lap swimming 4x/week.
RD follow-up 6 weeks.

NUTRITION FOLLOW-UP
Date: 05/25/2026
Food log reviewed: adherent most days, ~1800 kcal. Takeout 1x/week.
Adjustments: add protein at lunch; swap evening chips for fruit.
Reports keeping up with swimming 4x/week.
Continue program.

PRIMARY CARE PROGRESS NOTE
Date: 08/16/2026
S: Follow-up. Continues the diet and exercise plan and program visits since December. Frustrated: weight 73.7 kg today vs 75.7 kg when the plan began (-2.6%) despite reported adherence. Didn't bring a home BP log. Asks about medication. No MTC/MEN2 history, no pancreatitis.
O: Wt 73.7 kg, BMI 28.8. BP 135/86.
